description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Elected and declared as Vice Chairman of Koralaipattu, West Pradeshiya Sabha in Batticaloa District. The meeting held on the day of 19.07.2021 at 10.00 am at the Koralaipattu West Pradeshiya Sabha Hall
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a Vice Chairman for a local authority (Koralaipattu West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes and results at the local government level, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
